productConcept.name: Recto
productConcept.description: A precision document intelligence platform for editorial teams who care about the craft of language.
productConcept.rationale: The design system's EB Garamond bold at editorial scale, IBM Plex Sans body, pure white ground, 0.08em tracked headings, and generous 12-column grid with wide gutters evoke precision publishing and typographic craft. Recto — the right-hand page of an open book — names a product that brings structural intelligence to documents, consistent with the editorial register of the design system.
